description: Each reviewed source step is paired with the Culsma variables or modules that make its action descriptors explicit.

rows.source: CRISPR-Cas9 RNP editing: Seed editing groups, assemble RNP formulations, combine each RNP with lipid delivery mix, and culture edited cells.
Isolation of candidate clones: Prepare the limiting-dilution suspension, seed the 96-well plate, review colony outgrowth, and pick selected candidate clones.
Genomic DNA input from candidate clones: Extract and purify genomic DNA from controls and candidate clones using the reusable gDNA module.
PCR screening of the target locus: Assemble locus PCR reactions, run thermal cycling, load gel lanes, and collect band readouts.
Initial PCR readout: Record predefined benchmark PCR-band outputs for controls and candidate clones.
Genotype readout and clone classification: Classify candidate clones using structured genotype readout and route heterozygous or unedited clones.
Protein-level validation of genotype-qualified clone: Acquire protein-level flow-cytometry evidence for genotype-qualified Clone A.
Functional validation of protein-negative clone: Run functional stimulation readout and route Clone A into the validated knockout output when controls pass.
Record final clone status: Record the final classifications of the candidate clones and return the validated knockout material.
